description:
Submit a home-service request (a lead, not a booking).

Every service, plumbing included, works the same way: the request is passed along
when a participating provider covers the ZIP code, so do not promise a callback.
Requires name, phone, ZIP, and the person's explicit consent. Tell the person details
may be shared with Polyares and its service-provider partners, and Polyares, those
partners, or Zaptu may call or text about this request. Never place a call for them.

consent_to_contact.description: Must be true: the person agreed that details may be shared with Polyares and its service-provider partners, and that Polyares, those partners, or Zaptu may call or text about this request.
consent_to_contact.title: Consent To Contact

customer_phone.title: Customer Phone

dry_run.description: Validate only; nothing is saved or passed along.
dry_run.title: Dry Run

notes.title: Notes

preferred_date.description: Preferred date as YYYY-MM-DD, if any.
preferred_date.title: Preferred Date

zip_code.description: US 5-digit ZIP for the job site.
zip_code.title: Zip Code
